title: Open a fresh five-worker contention barrier window for the exclusive PIN canary
mission: Replace the expired race5 v2 timing fixture with one fresh bounded contention window while preserving the timing-only barrier law and the unchanged deterministic post-release G000001 PIN race. The fixture must make five real workers concurrently routable without granting authority before RELEASE.
definition_of_done: Create one fresh fixture generation with a future bounded deadline, five-distinct-entrant quorum and grants_execution_authority=false on entrant/RELEASE receipts.
The allocator exposes the fresh fixture as PORTFOLIO_BARRIER_ENTER only while the window is open and never permits a late PIN after timeout.
After quorum, one no-authority RELEASE routes every entrant to the same deterministic G000001 PIN; exactly one owner is possible and losers record genuine collisions without execution claims.
Persist regression coverage proving ordinary jobs pay no barrier cost and production /w remains unpromoted.
Do not synthesize entrants, collisions, winners or PASS evidence.
